Under $30 for real Indian food in Phu Quoc. 100% vegetarian. 4.9 stars from 176 reviews.

Maharaja Lounge sits right in Sunset Town beside Starbucks. Authentic curries, dal, fresh bread, zero meat on the menu. If you've been surviving on seafood all week, this hits different.

Great for vegetarians who thought Phu Quoc had nothing for them. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
